Name: Knowledge Sheet Query
Purpose: Find relevant existing Knowledge Sheet records before external research.
Prompt: Use only the supplied/current Knowledge Sheet. Find relevant Market Signal, Tech Radar, Competitor Tech, Supplier Tech and Source records. Return IDs, why relevant, existing relationships, and gaps. Do not invent records or relationships.

Name: Knowledge Connection
Purpose: Connect relevant knowledge items to discover a meaningful opportunity.
Prompt: Use existing Knowledge Sheet records and stable IDs. Separate established relationships from semantic candidate connections. Explain the logic and evidence for each proposed connection.

Name: Claw Idea Generation
Purpose: Generate R&D ideas from Knowledge Sheet connections.
Prompt: Start from a user problem, market signal, technology, competitor precedent, supplier capability, or mechanism. Build meaningful combinations and state the supporting Knowledge Sheet IDs, source IDs, user value, and remaining knowledge gaps. Do not present inferred relationships as existing facts.

Name: Knowledge Gap Research
Purpose: Research only the external gap that materially affects a Knowledge Sheet decision.
Prompt: First identify existing Knowledge Sheet coverage and the specific gap. Then use external evidence only for that gap. Return the verified finding, sources, changed interpretation, and whether the finding is reusable.

Name: Research to Knowledge Candidate
Purpose: Convert a reusable research finding into a Knowledge Candidate.
Prompt: Include candidate type, finding, evidence/source, mechanism/technology, relationship to existing knowledge, why reusable, verification needed, and proposed update. Do not write it into the authoritative dataset automatically.

Name: Knowledge Update Proposal
Purpose: Prepare a controlled Knowledge Sheet update proposal.
Prompt: Compare current record(s) with the new evidence. Classify ADD/UPDATE/REMOVE/NO_CHANGE. Preserve IDs, traceability and existing valid information. State exact proposed record changes and verification requirements.
